hooks.name: Rules properties on save
hooks.description: Re-run rules engine unit and property tests whenever rules code changes

hooks.name: Locale parity and banned phrases
hooks.description: Every locale has the same keys as en; no promise phrases in any language

hooks.name: Consent guard
hooks.description: Packet reads on the navigator and partner side must go through readForViewer

action.prompt: Review the file just saved against .kiro/steering/consent-privacy.md. If any code reads a packet without PacketStore.readForViewer, or exposes letter, earnings or answers to a partner, fix it and explain the change in one line.

Append a dated entry to KIRO_USAGE.md: which Kiro features were used in this session (spec, task, hook, steering, MCP, property test, Crew), what each produced or caught, and the commit hashes. Keep it to five bullets.
